title: 都说年轻人只看手机：影院却靠他们翻身，全球票房涨15%靠谁撑？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Another form of entertainment is gaining back popularity. Hollywood is having its best year since 2019 as moviegoers head back to the theatre and in

segments.en: droves, global ticket sales are up 15, 15 percent from last year with five films topping the billion dollar mark. Joining us now
segments.zh: 全球票房比去年增长15%，已有五部影片突破十亿美元大关。
